ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read “Comparison Chart of the Total Amount of Solar Radiation in China and the World at the Same Latitudes.” <image1> According to the diagram, near which latitude is the region where the difference in annual total solar radiation among different regions of China is the greatest?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis represents latitude, marked with 20°, 25°, 30°, 35°, 40°, 45°, etc.; the vertical axis represents the annual total amount of solar radiation. In the figure there are high-value curves and low-value curves corresponding to different regions of China, and there is a “global” same-latitude curve as a comparison. Then reason: The question asks “the difference in annual total solar radiation among different regions of China is the greatest,” so the vertical distance between China’s high-value curve and low-value curve should be compared at the same latitude. Observing the positions of 20°N, 25°N, 30°N, 35°N, 40°N, etc., near 30°N the upper-lower distance between the two curves of China is the widest, indicating that the difference in annual total solar radiation is the greatest.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有纬度横轴和太阳辐射总量纵轴，包含我国不同地区的高、低值曲线以及全球曲线。根据题干“我国不同地区年太阳辐射总量差异最大”，只比较同一纬度上我国高值曲线与低值曲线的垂直距离。沿20°N、25°N、30°N、35°N、40°N等位置观察，30°N附近上下两条我国曲线之间的距离最宽，因此答案为30°N附近。
